title: Working with Thelonious Monk at Newport in 1964
summary: His one time with Monk was a festival jam set at Newport in 1964, where Monk played his own modern ideas.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Playing with and understanding Thelonious Monk

blocks.x: And so now, since you've -- oh, I know
one thing I forgot to ask you about, I'm sorry. You told me that you had worked with Thelonius Monk.
Yes, I worked with Thelonius. The first time I actually worked with him was at the Newport Jazz Festival. I worked with him on one of the sets, you know, and this took place in 1964.
Oh, you worked with him in 1964, uh-huh.
Yeah, one of the sets, you know.
Who else was in the band, do you recall?

Oh, it was a mixed-up group. You know how they do at those festivals. They put everybody -- anybody with anybody else, you know. They mix up -- they don't have any definite sets. It makes it hard to remember (inaudible).
Oh, they just -- kind of a jam situation.
How did he play that gig?
And of course, Thelonius -- I kept up with him, you know. He played his -- he has his own ideas, rather modern, so to speak, and that was the one time I worked with Thelonius.
